title: Adaptive microdevice placement simulation

creators.name: Hata, Nobuhiko
creators.affiliation: Brigham and Women's Hospital, Harvard Medical School

description: Simulation code for the preliminary studies (P2) of an NIH R01 renewal on adaptive MRI-guided placement of implantable microdevices in prostate cancer. lesion_sim_3d.py is a 3D model on 220 expert-delineated PI-CAI lesions in which each implantable microdevice (IMD) is a 6.5 mm device along the needle path; anatomic_lesion_sim.py is a 2D anatomic model on PI-CAI lesion cross-sections; mc_adaptive_microdevice.py is a 2D didactic model. Lesion masks are not included: fetch_picai_lesions.sh downloads them from the PI-CAI dataset (Saha A, Bosma JS, et al. Lancet Oncol 2024;25(7):879-887, doi:10.1016/S1470-2045(24)00220-1; https://github.com/DIAGNijmegen/picai_labels), which is licensed separately under CC BY-NC 4.0. The CC BY 4.0 license of this record covers the code only.
notes: Code development was assisted by Claude (Anthropic), an AI assistant.
references: Saha A, Bosma JS, Twilt JJ, et al. Artificial intelligence and radiologists in prostate cancer detection on MRI (PI-CAI): an international, paired, non-inferiority, confirmatory study. Lancet Oncol. 2024;25(7):879-887. doi:10.1016/S1470-2045(24)00220-1
